sections.label: Banking
sections.title: Security Pacific, <t>1979 to 1992.</t>
sections.lede: From branch operations to the restructuring of classified loans. Security Pacific was acquired by Bank of America in 1992.

groups.label: Security Pacific National Bank
names: Senior Vice President, Division Administrator, Real Estate Special Assets — 1990–1992. A classified loan portfolio of about $1.6 billion in commitments, across ten relationships
First Vice President, Regional Manager, Real Estate Industries Group — 1987–1990. A loan portfolio of $1 billion in outstanding commitments

First Vice President, Deputy Administrator and Credit Officer, Real Estate Industries Group — 1986–1987. Credit policy for a $6 billion real estate portfolio across California, with personal approval authority of $15 million
Vice President, Regional Manager, Real Estate Industries Group, Riverside — 1984–1986. Opened the regional office; a construction loan portfolio grown to $700 million
Vice President, World Corporate Group — 1983–1984. A corporate loan portfolio of $500 million in commitments
Vice President, Real Estate Special Assets — 1980–1983. Restructure and collection of $50 million in classified real estate loans
Assistant Vice President, Credit Review — 1980. Field audits of loan portfolios across the United States
Assistant Branch Manager — 1979–1980. Branch operations, deposit accounts and consumer loans

groups.label: Before Security Pacific
names: UCB, Bay Area Financial and Liberty Loan — 1973–1979. Branch manager, credit manager, loan underwriter and collection officer

groups.label: A de novo bank
names: Banco BuenaVentura, Oxnard — 2006–2008. De novo President and Chief Credit Officer, approved by California’s Department of Financial Institutions and the FDIC, with a business plan to bring the unbanked into the banking system

sections.fn: From the CV of December 2016. The firm’s biography describes the 1990–1992 role as Senior Vice President in charge of the Restructuring Group.

sections.label: Rodriguez & Associates
sections.title: An advisory practice <t>since 1992.</t>
sections.lede: Founded to resolve complex debtor-creditor transactions secured by real estate, stock and partnership interests; today also brokerage, capital procurement, site acquisition and litigation support.

groups.label: Public and community work
names: Los Angeles Unified School District — 2000–2002. Consulting Senior Facilities Executive for three of eleven mini-districts; sites designated for 33 schools, 38% of the District’s 2002 new building program
Pro bono — since 2009. Negotiating with lenders on behalf of homeowners at risk of foreclosure, and testimony in cases against predatory lenders and foreclosure rescue scams

groups.label: Representative clients, from the 2016 CV
names: Real estate: Maguire Thomas Partners, Kilroy Industries, The Carson Companies, Peninsula Beverly Hills
Financial institutions: Bank of America, ING Bank, Bankers Trust Securities, East West Bank, Far East National Bank

sections.fn: The firm’s totals differ by source: matters in excess of $4.5 billion for over 300 clients on its website, more than $9 billion for hundreds of clients in the 2016 CV. Left out until he confirms them.
